scope: Six targeted authored controls; repeated administrative field names favor table encoding. Not representative or independent generalization evaluation.
ordering: Alternate plain/table order by case; sequential, no automatic retries
local_acceptance: Same selected entity names, fields, values, conflicts, sources, coverage and limits; representation never expands UTF-8 bytes. Inspect actual BudgetTracker admission over 200,250,300,400,600,900.
live_acceptance: No loss of correct solutions or justified refusals; compare actual usage on matched successfully submitted pairs separately from constrained admission cases.
candidate: JSON table used only when strictly shorter; no fields or sources removed. Original selected entity set unchanged.
production: Experimental candidate; production default remains plain during comparison.
stop_rule: Unknown cost stops this separately budgeted experiment; prior E46/E50 ledgers remain unchanged.
